8e3a93fcca6aadef745baf1a682cf860b49eb9e5.sourceText: 把 `quantileZ` 调大，通常会抬高代表地面：较高点的高差可能减小，较低点的高差却可能增大。因此不能照搬“调大就更容易上下坡”。应一起看正常坡面、小台阶和低障碍，确认地面估计是否偏高或偏低。这里没有正负高差相加抵消，也没有允许上坡／禁止下坡的专用开关。
8e3a93fcca6aadef745baf1a682cf860b49eb9e5.translatedText: Increasing `quantileZ` usually raises the represented ground: the height difference at higher points may decrease, while the height difference at lower points may increase\. Therefore, one cannot simply assume that “increasing it makes going up and down slopes easier\.” One should consider normal slopes, small steps, and low obstacles together to confirm whether the ground estimate is too high or too low\. Here there is no cancellation by adding positive and negative height differences, nor is there a dedicated switch to allow uphill or prohibit downhill\.

8ebe60b3efd7270da4318dd6bbcd5c7f00372830.translatedText: When False, PCD saving is disabled, while estimation and mapping continue; when True, registered scans in the camera_init coordinate system are accumulated and saved as binary PCD\.
